full-name: The Rev. Canon Arthur Rawson Ashwell
first-name: Arthur Rawson
last-name: Ashwell
prefix: The Rev. Canon
title: The Rev. Canon Arthur Rawson Ashwell
dates: (1824-23 October 1879)
---

contributor to MP (1867-77) and to the Monthly Paper of Sunday Teaching

He married (1854) Elizabeth Fixsen (b. 1822/3). He served from 1870 as principal of Chichester Theological College, from 1864-76 he was editor of the Literary Churchman and from 1876 of the Church Quarterly Review.
